# @rnw-community/nestjs-rxjs-lock

> NestJS module for Redis-backed distributed locking via Redlock, exposing an RxJS `Observable` API. Depends on
> `@nestjs/common`, `@nestjs/core`, `@nestjs-modules/ioredis`, `ioredis`, `redlock`, and `rxjs`.

Wrap the typed module and service returned by `NestJSRxJSLockModule.registerTypedAsync<E>()` in your own module so lock
prefixes stay type-safe; lock keys take the form `lock:[prefix]:[name]`, and `lock$` errors when the lock is not acquired.

## Landing

- [readme.md](readme.md): Typed module setup, `registerTypedAsync` options, and `lock$` usage.

## Guides

- [Configuration](readme.md#configuration): Wrapping the typed module and service with a type-safe lock-code enum.

## API reference

- [`NestJSRxJSLockModule`](readme.md#nestjsrxjslockmoduleregistertypedasync): Module whose `registerTypedAsync<E>(options?)` returns a `[DynamicModule, LockService]` tuple bound to Redis.
- [`NestJSRxJSLockService`](readme.md#nestjsrxjsservicelock): Abstract service whose `lock$(name, prefix, handler$, expireInMs?)` runs `handler$` while holding a Redlock lock.
- [`NestJSRxJSLockModuleOptions`](readme.md#nestjsrxjslockmoduleregistertypedasync): Redlock `Settings` extended with `defaultExpireMs`.
- [`defaultNestJSRxJSLockModuleOptions`](readme.md#nestjsrxjslockmoduleregistertypedasync): Default options merged under the ones passed to `registerTypedAsync` (`defaultExpireMs: 10000`, `retryCount: 0`).
